playtest.intro.01.text:
Hey friends — thanks for playtesting my game, {game_title}.
Just a few notes before you jump in.

playtest.intro.02.text: First. This game is in early prototype mode. The things I most want to hear from your feedback are about what is fun, what is boring, what is confusing, and what things you think I should add to the game.

playtest.intro.03.text: Second. Be honest and picky! You don't need to consider anyone else's perspective. I just want to hear yours.

playtest.intro.04.text: And finally, have fun! Break the game, find cool combos, test the limits. And don't be afraid to dream big with your requests.

playtest.intro.05.text: This is the menu you'll land on.

playtest.intro.06.text: **Brand New** starts from the beginning, as if you had never played.

playtest.intro.07.text: **Middle Progress** puts you a few dungeons in, with some items already unlocked.

playtest.intro.08.text: **Continue** picks up your last playtest save.

playtest.intro.09.text: **Feedback** opens a note to me. Use it for anything that is not tied to one card.

playtest.intro.10.text: You can right-click any item or monster in the game and leave feedback. That is useful for bugs, confusion, or balance issues.

playtest.intro.11.text: For general comments while you play, click **Feedback** in the bottom right, or press **F2**.

playtest.intro.12.text: This is the F2 screen. Type a note, click Send, and it goes to my game development console. Next time I sit down to work, I will see it and can make the fix or the change.

playtest.intro.13.text: However — for those who want to give the best kind of feedback, I would love to actually HEAR your experience.

playtest.intro.14.text: Consider taking your phone, setting it to a voice memo or recorder, and just letting it run while you play. Talk out loud about your thought process, your first impressions, your feedback, anything at all.

playtest.intro.15.text: Then send me the entire file when you are done, because I can turn that into a much more detailed look at your player experience. If you are interested in doing that, you can email the files to me at nathan.elequin@gmail.com.

playtest.intro.16.text: So thank you again for playtesting. If you have any questions, you can always reach out to me. Now enjoy!

playtest.play_chip.text: Right-click a Monster/Item, or press F2, to send a note.

playtest.right_click_hint.text: Right-click any item or monster to leave a comment.

playtest.screenshot.text: You can screenshot this screen and send it.

playtest.send_failed.text: Could not send. Copied to the clipboard instead.

playtest.tier_blurb.text: Rank cards of the same strength against each other. Drag a card onto a row.

playtest.voice_chip.text: Keep a phone voice memo running. Talk out loud at every interaction.

tutorial.line.001.text: Hey there, greedy goblin. I'm {nib}. I was just in the middle of enjoying my nap when you had to barge into this dungeon and start swiping loot left n' right!

tutorial.line.002.text: Well, now you've gone and done it — the monsters are coming to claim their stuff, and you're going to have to defend yourself with that loot or else die in this strange catacomb.

tutorial.line.003.text: Welcome to the Merry Go' Round of doom — a series of circular catacombs that rotate around this particular spot. Don't ask me why, the architect of this dungeon doesn't like answering questions.

tutorial.line.004.text: This is a Corridor — there are 8 in total. Monsters will pop into these slots as they line up to clean your clock and take your junk.

tutorial.line.005.text: This is your loot. Looks like you started off with some basic loot for this tutorial, but you'll find lots of fancy weapons and armor out here.

tutorial.line.007.text:
...is to get out of the dungeon with as much loot as possible.
...Got it?

tutorial.line.008.text: Okay, let me show you how things work a'ROUND these parts.

tutorial.line.010.text: You have 6 health (HP). You can never have more than 6. If it reaches 0 at any point, you're dead.

tutorial.line.011.text: When you complete a Dungeon (clear out this wheel), you will heal back to full HP. Spend your HP wisely.

tutorial.line.012.text: Alright, that's enough. Let's learn the rest as we go. Click Spin. The wheel picks a monster at random. You don't choose who stops in front of you. I'll show you Moves in a minute — that's how you walk to someone. Until then, Spin is a roll.

tutorial.line.013.text: Ahh, a crotchety ol' wizard, eh?
tutorial.line.013.where: If the wheel landed on Wizard · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.014.text: He looks pretty scary — 5 Attack would nearly kill you in one strike.
tutorial.line.014.where: If the wheel landed on Wizard · continue / atk · Nib line

tutorial.line.015.text: ...but he's also super frail. Most weapons will kill him before he gets to strike.
tutorial.line.015.where: If the wheel landed on Wizard · continue / hp · Nib line

tutorial.line.016.text: Use the Sai. It will kill him and end the fight.

tutorial.line.038.text: Items change all the time based on circumstances. Your job is to juggle your loot to maximize their effectiveness against the unique enemies in the dungeon.

tutorial.line.043.text: You get three Moves for a dungeon. The feet on the wheel. A Move walks you to the next living monster. It does not Spin.

tutorial.line.044.text: Hold on. I'll turn you to the Bandit so you can try a Move. That turn is not a Spin you pressed.
tutorial.line.044.where: After the fight · face / wheel · Nib line

tutorial.line.045.text: The Cube is beside him. Spin onto that Cube and it eats one of your items. This arrow walks you there. Your items stay in your hand.
tutorial.line.045.where: After the fight · move / move_arrow · Nib line

tutorial.line.046.text: It did not eat a thing. That spent one Move. Two are left, and they do not come back this dungeon.
tutorial.line.046.where: After the fight · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.047.text: This Sai is already showing 4. That drops the Cube.
tutorial.line.047.where: After the fight · item:sai / item:sai · Nib line

tutorial.line.048.text: Cube's down. The Shuriken walks you without spending a Move, then it hits.
tutorial.line.048.where: After the fight · item:shuriken / item:shuriken · Nib line

tutorial.line.049.text: That walk was free. The Bandit had 3 health, so he dropped.
tutorial.line.049.where: After the fight · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.050.text: There's one final type of item. Click Spin. I'll park this one on the Goblin so you can read his ability.
tutorial.line.050.where: If Goblin is still waiting · spin / spin · Nib line

tutorial.line.051.text: Aww, look at this little guy! He is so cute...but he also has an ability.
tutorial.line.051.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.052.text: Hover any monster to learn their ability, just like items.
tutorial.line.052.where: If Goblin is still waiting · hover_shift / wheel · Nib line

tutorial.line.053.text: Aw, Goblins are 'Evasive', so they cannot take Attack damage! Looks like our Knucklers would be wasted here.
tutorial.line.053.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.054.text: But wait...this item is a Special Item. It doesn't Attack or Block. Take a look.
tutorial.line.054.where: If Goblin is still waiting · hover_shift / wheel · Nib line

tutorial.line.055.text: This item allows you to instantly Defeat an Enemy if you have more HP than them!
tutorial.line.055.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.056.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.057.text: ...but are you sure you want to use it?
tutorial.line.057.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.058.text: So far you've lost zero HP in this dungeon, but remember — each time you clear a Dungeon, you heal back to full.
tutorial.line.058.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.059.text: AND you get to keep all of the Loot that you didn't use in this dungeon. Pretty sweet, huh?
tutorial.line.059.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.060.text: So I'll give you a choice. You can use The Boot and get the sweet satisfaction of stomping this Goblin into the dirt...
tutorial.line.060.where: If Goblin is still waiting · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.061.text: ...Orrrr you can let him slice you up, and keep it. The choice is yours.
tutorial.line.061.where: If Goblin is still waiting · choice / item:da_boot · Nib line

tutorial.line.062.text: Honestly, I respect it. Those Goblins are super annoying, so here's a tip:
tutorial.line.062.where: If they used The Boot · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.063.text: If you see one in your upcoming Dungeon, you should always hold onto a Block or Defeat item to avoid that damage.
tutorial.line.063.where: If they used The Boot · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.064.text: You won't always have a Boot, after all.
tutorial.line.064.where: If they used The Boot · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.065.where: If they took the hit · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.066.text: Well the next time that Boot saves you from death in a future Dungeon, you'll be glad you let that little rascal nick you for 3.
tutorial.line.066.where: If they took the hit · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.067.text: I'm sure you can tell, but I'll give you a tip straight from the source:
tutorial.line.067.where: If they took the hit · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.068.text: Spend your HP like it was made of gold. Sometimes it will be correct to drop to 1 HP — you'll find Items that reward you for losing HP — we call that Bleeding.
tutorial.line.068.where: If they took the hit · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.069.text: You made it through the practice wheel.
tutorial.line.069.where: After the fight · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.070.text: Deeper in, a death pulls the next monster out of the deck, and the loot matches whoever walked in. The monster who uses the last card still pays you. Once the deck is empty, the seat closes and you get no more loot. You live on what you are holding.
tutorial.line.070.where: After the fight · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.line.071.text: Come back. Each dungeon you finish, new monsters and new loot join in. The deeper you go, the stranger they get.
tutorial.line.071.where: After the fight · continue / (none) · Nib line

tutorial.nudge_item.text: Click the highlighted thing — not that one.
tutorial.nudge_item.where: Wrong item during How to Play

tutorial.nudge_wait.where: Wrong click during How to Play

warn.boot.text: Can't — they're as healthy as you, or healthier.

warn.crossbow.text: Can't — no soft neighbor who can take a bolt.

warn.sledge.text: Can't — they don't hit hard enough.
